issues.description: Method Farm.singFarmSong(): the problem statement (UML) and the template declare singFarmSong() as returning void and describe it as printing the song, while the solution implementation declares singFarmSong() with return type String (returning the song text). This discrepancy conflicts on the method's return type and expected behavior (printing vs returning) and will confuse students which signature to implement and may cause compilation/test mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature and behavior across artifacts. Prefer following the problem statement and template: change the solution's singFarmSong() signature to public void singFarmSong() and modify its implementation to print the song (e.g., call a helper that prints each verse or print the concatenated song via System.out.println). Alternatively, if the intended API is to return the song text, update the problem statement/UML and the template to declare singFarmSong(): String and document that it should return the full song text instead of printing.
